name: Ruijie Networks Co., Ltd.
summary: Ruijie Networks Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research, and sale of network equipment, network security products, and cloud desktop solutions in China and internationally. The company offers switches, such as campus network, and data center and cloud computing, as well as SDN, industry selected exchange series, and accessories; core, aggregation, access, and mobile routers; and access point products, including launch-type wireless, wall-mounted wireless, smart wireless, outdoor wireless, scenario-based wireless, wireless controller, industry-selected wireless series, and wireless management and applications.
